c09-fountain-wall.why: S1 round 2 (hero lane rebuilt the fountain; look lane re-pose): frontal on gate B (heading 30.3 = the wall's normal, pitch -2: in c09-day.jpg the eye line (1.6 m on the 2.7 m door) sits 57 px above the frame centre, i.e. the camera looks 2.4 deg down; the spec's +3 was a medium-confidence fit), 6.2 m out and 0.3 m east of the gate, so the gate sits at 45 % of the width and the fountain (3.5 m east of the gate, its left edge 2.2 m) enters at the right edge as in c09-day.jpg. The photo was taken 8-12 m from the wall; in the compiled lane that point is under the opposite shop awning or inside the building, so the camera stands at 6.2 m (the awning's front edge stays above the frame) and vFOV 43 (39.2 in the photo) recovers the framing. Ray casts: no people between the camera and the gate.

cafe.why: S1 critique: from the record's street view (3.4 m out, 0.5 m west of the door, under the parasol) the canopy filled the top 30 % and 'day' did not read. 2 m further out along the facade normal (5.4 m) and 1.7 m east of it (1.2 m east of the door), looking at the door: the parasol moves to the left third, the pavement, sign and awning are in frame. No sunlit pavement is possible here at 16:00: Yasa Cd runs 119/299 deg and the sun stands at 238 deg / 33 deg, so both sides are in shade.
